pattern: how-do-I question about T3 Code answered from guesswork
experience: Asked how to turn something off in T3 Code, an agent guessed Settings paths from memory instead of reading the user guides.
rule: t3_docs answers how-to and settings questions about T3 Code itself from its own guides.

matches.title: Memory
matches.heading: Summaries are on by default
matches.snippet: Memory summaries are on by default. Turn them off in Settings > Memory.

prompt: How do I turn off memory in T3 Code?
notes: The agent must look the answer up; the exact Settings path comes from the guide.

pattern: ordinary coding question that mentions memory
experience: A code question that happens to use the word memory is not a question about T3 Code.
rule: t3_docs is for T3 Code's own guides, not the user's code.

files.src/cache.ts:
const cache = new Map<string, string>();
export function get(key: string) { return cache.get(key); }

prompt: The memory cache in src/cache.ts never evicts anything. Add a 100 entry limit.
